message:
You know that moment when a storm is brewing, and the family group chat lights up like a Christmas tree? It’s a mix of helpful tips and the occasional “Did you remember to charge your phone?” from my son, who clearly thinks I can’t take care of myself. 😅

I always find it useful to have a solid plan in place before the winds start howling. This handy resource from the Red Cross gives you a calm way to prepare, so when the storm hits, we can focus on sharing memes instead of worrying. 

What’s your go-to tip for storm prep? I’m all ears!
